def wrap(client, **workflow_attributes):
    """
    Wrap an LLM client or agent instance to auto-trace all calls.

    Supports: OpenAI, AsyncOpenAI, AzureOpenAI, AsyncAzureOpenAI, Anthropic,
    AsyncAnthropic, google.genai.Client (Gemini + Vertex AI), boto3
    bedrock-runtime, CrewAI Crew, Pydantic AI Agent, DSPy modules, Agno
    Agent/Team/Workflow, Google ADK Runner, Strands Agent, Hermes AIAgent,
    OpenRouter.

        >>> import neatlogs, openai
        >>> client = neatlogs.wrap(openai.OpenAI())
        >>> client.chat.completions.create(...)

    Workflow metadata can be bound at wrap time. Keyword arguments are stamped
    on the root WORKFLOW span as ``neatlogs.workflow.*`` so they show in the
    metadata drawer and trace search. Session identity belongs in
    ``neatlogs.identify(...)``.

        >>> client = neatlogs.wrap(
        ...     openai.OpenAI(),
        ...     project_id="project_123",
        ...     route="/api/v1/copilot/chat",
        ...     surface="copilot",
        ...     mode="fast",
        ... )
        >>> with neatlogs.identify(session_id="chat_123", end_user_id="user_456"):
        ...     client.chat.completions.create(...)
    """
    from ._wrap_utils import make_wrap_context, with_wrap_context

    wrap_context = make_wrap_context(workflow_attributes)

    def _finish(wrapped):
        return with_wrap_context(wrapped, wrap_context)

    cls_name = type(client).__name__
    module = type(client).__module__ or ""

    # Debug: record every wrap() call — the object type and the call site — so a
    # user can confirm WHICH object was wrapped and from WHERE.
    try:
        from .init import is_debug_enabled

        if is_debug_enabled():
            import inspect

            from .core.logger import get_logger

            _c = inspect.stack()[1]
            get_logger().debug(
                f"[neatlogs.wrap] wrapping {cls_name} (module={module}) "
                f"— called from {_c.filename}:{_c.lineno} (in {_c.function})"
            )
    except Exception:
        pass

    # Also fingerprint the full MRO so subclasses defined in user code are
    # detected — e.g. `class QAPipeline(dspy.Module)` has __module__ "src.pipeline"
    # but `dspy.module` appears in a base class. Used as a fallback when the leaf
    # class's own module doesn't reveal the framework.
    mro_modules = " ".join((getattr(base, "__module__", "") or "") for base in type(client).__mro__)

    # Azure OpenAI must be checked before plain OpenAI: AzureOpenAI subclasses
    # OpenAI and its module ("openai.lib.azure") contains "openai".
    if cls_name in ("AzureOpenAI", "AsyncAzureOpenAI"):
        from .azure_openai import wrap_async_azure_openai_client, wrap_azure_openai_client

        if "Async" in cls_name:
            return _finish(wrap_async_azure_openai_client(client))
        return _finish(wrap_azure_openai_client(client))

    kind: str,
    name: Optional[str] = None,
    *,

    description: Optional[str] = None,
    version: Optional[str] = None,
    tags: Optional[list[str]] = None,

    goal: Optional[str] = None,
    # Tool-specific

    parameters: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    # Session grouping (groups the traces of a conversation; set on the WORKFLOW root)
    session_id: Optional[str] = None,
    # End-user identity (one end-user per trace; usually set on the WORKFLOW root)
    end_user_id: Optional[str] = None,
    end_user_metadata: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
) -> Callable[[F], F]:
    """
    Universal decorator for instrumenting custom code with observability spans.

    This is the single, unified decorator that replaces @workflow, @agent, @chain, etc.
    Specify the span type using the `kind` parameter.

    Args:
        kind: OpenInference span kind - one of:
              "WORKFLOW" - Top-level orchestration entry point
              "AGENT" - Agent execution with optional role/goal
              "CHAIN" - Generic sequential steps/processing
              "TOOL" - Tool or function call
              "RETRIEVER" - RAG retrieval operation
              "EMBEDDING" - Embedding generation
              "MCP_TOOL" - MCP protocol tool call
        name: Optional span name (defaults to function name)
        description: Human-readable description
        version: Version identifier for tracking changes
        tags: List of tags for filtering/grouping
        capture_input: Whether to capture function input (default: True)
        capture_output: Whether to capture function output (default: True)

        # Agent-specific parameters (when kind="AGENT"):
        role: Agent role description (also sets agent.name)
        goal: Agent goal/objective

        # Tool-specific parameters (when kind="TOOL" or kind="MCP_TOOL"):
        tool_name: Tool identifier
        parameters: Tool parameter schema

        # End-user identity (typically only on the WORKFLOW root):
        end_user_id: Identifier of the END-USER this trace belongs to — the user

    """
    Infer OpenInference span kind from span name.

    Distinguishes RETRIEVER (read ops) vs VECTOR_STORE (write ops) for vector DBs.

    name_lower = span_name.lower()

    # LLM operations
    if any(

            "anthropic",
            "cohere",
            "bedrock",
            "chat",
            "completion",
            "llm",
            "gemini",
            "google_genai",
        ]
    ):
        return "LLM"

    # Embedding operations
    elif "embed" in name_lower:
        return "EMBEDDING"

    # Vector DB: Distinguish RETRIEVER (read) vs VECTOR_STORE (write)
    elif any(
        db in name_lower
        for db in [
            "chroma",
            "pinecone",
            "weaviate",
            "qdrant",
            "milvus",
            "lancedb",

    ):

"""Explicit model spans for the LiteLLM/ChatOpenAI provider path.

Locked-SDK support audit (neatlogs 1.4.26):
- `neatlogs.wrap()` documents raw OpenAI/AsyncOpenAI clients, not
  LangChain's `ChatOpenAI`. Chat-model capture rides on OpenInference
  LangChain instrumentation, which recorded zero LLM spans for a
  completed proxy-path run (trace `608bd91b...`: llm_calls 0).
- Supported explicit API: `neatlogs.trace(name, kind=..., **attributes)`
  plus `span.set_attribute` / `set_status` on the yielded span.

This module therefore emits exactly one explicit LLM span per model
generation on the ChatOpenAI path, using OpenInference attribute names
so the backend counts it (`openinference.span.kind = "LLM"`). Each
generation is counted once: one span per `_generate` / `_agenerate` /
`_stream` / `_astream` call. Token usage is recorded only when the
provider returns it; absent usage is omitted (unknown), never zero.
`requests_spent` (queue record) stays a separate client-side count.

Secrets: message content is synthetic order data, but anything shaped
like a credential is scrubbed before capture. Error paths record the
error type only, then re-raise so budget/queue semantics are unchanged.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
import time

import neatlogs
from langchain_openai import ChatOpenAI

_MAX_CHARS = 4000

_SECRET_PATTERNS = (
    re.compile(r"(?i)\b(api[_-]?key|api[_-]?secret|bearer|authorization)\b"
               r"\s*[:=]\s*\S+"),
    re.compile(r"\bsk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}\b"),
    re.compile(r"\bLITELLM_API_KEY\b\s*=\s*\S+"),
    re.compile(r"\bGEMINI_API_KEY\b\s*=\s*\S+"),
)


def sanitize(text: object) -> str:
    """Render and scrub text for span capture. Never raises."""
    try:
        rendered = text if isinstance(text, str) else json.dumps(
            text, sort_keys=True, default=str)
    except Exception:
        return "<unserializable>"
    for pattern in _SECRET_PATTERNS:
        rendered = pattern.sub("[credential]", rendered)
    if len(rendered) > _MAX_CHARS:
        rendered = rendered[:_MAX_CHARS] + "…[truncated]"
    return rendered


def _message_dicts(messages) -> list:
    out = []
    for message in messages or []:
        try:
            kind = type(message).__name__
            content = getattr(message, "content", "")
            row = {"type": kind, "content": sanitize(content)}
            name = getattr(message, "name", None)
            if name:
                row["name"] = sanitize(name)
            out.append(row)
        except Exception:
            out.append({"type": "?", "content": "<unserializable>"})
    return out


def extract_usage(result) -> dict | None:
    """Provider-returned token usage, or None when absent (unknown)."""
    try:
        generations = getattr(result, "generations", None) or []
        message = generations[0].message if generations else None
        meta = getattr(message, "usage_metadata", None) if message else None
        if isinstance(meta, dict):
            usage = {}
            if isinstance(meta.get("input_tokens"), int):
                usage["prompt"] = meta["input_tokens"]
            if isinstance(meta.get("output_tokens"), int):
                usage["completion"] = meta["output_tokens"]
            if isinstance(meta.get("total_tokens"), int):
                usage["total"] = meta["total_tokens"]
            if usage:
                return usage
        llm_output = getattr(result, "llm_output", None)
        if isinstance(llm_output, dict):
            raw = llm_output.get("token_usage") or {}
            usage = {}
            for source, dest in (("prompt_tokens", "prompt"),
                                 ("completion_tokens", "completion"),
                                 ("total_tokens", "total")):
                if isinstance(raw.get(source), int):
                    usage[dest] = raw[source]
            if usage:
                return usage
    except Exception:
        return None
    return None


def _output_texts(result) -> str:
    try:
        return sanitize([
            getattr(gen.message, "content", "")
            for gen in (getattr(result, "generations", None) or [])])
    except Exception:
        return "<unserializable>"


class InstrumentedChatOpenAI(ChatOpenAI):
    """ChatOpenAI with one explicit LLM span per generation.

    Production behavior is inherited untouched; only observability is
    added. Used for the LiteLLM-proxy branch of `build_model`.
    """

    def _model_id(self) -> str:
        for attr in ("model_name", "model"):
            try:
                value = getattr(self, attr, None)
                if value:
                    return str(value)
            except Exception:
                continue
        return "unknown"

    def _llm_span(self, messages):
        return neatlogs.trace(
            "chatopenai generate", kind="LLM",
            **{"llm.model_name": self._model_id(),
               "llm.input_messages": sanitize(_message_dicts(messages)),
               "swapdesk.provider": "litellm-proxy",
               "swapdesk.evidence": "explicit-model-span"})

    def _record_usage(self, span, result) -> None:
        usage = extract_usage(result)
        if not usage:
            return  # Unknown, never zero.
        if "prompt" in usage:
            span.set_attribute("llm.token_count.prompt", usage["prompt"])
        if "completion" in usage:
            span.set_attribute("llm.token_count.completion",
                               usage["completion"])
        if "total" in usage:
            span.set_attribute("llm.token_count.total", usage["total"])

    def _record_error(self, span, exc: BaseException) -> None:
        try:
            span.set_attribute("error.type", type(exc).__name__)
            span.set_status("ERROR")
        except Exception:
            pass

    def _generate(self, messages, stop=None, run_manager=None, **kwargs):
        started = time.monotonic()
        with self._llm_span(messages) as span:
            try:
                result = super()._generate(
                    messages, stop=stop, run_manager=run_manager, **kwargs)
            except Exception as exc:
                self._record_error(span, exc)
                raise
            span.set_attribute("llm.output_messages",
                               _output_texts(result))
            self._record_usage(span, result)
            span.set_attribute("swapdesk.latency_ms",
                               int((time.monotonic() - started) * 1000))
            return result

    async def _agenerate(self, messages, stop=None, run_manager=None,
                         **kwargs):
        started = time.monotonic()
        with self._llm_span(messages) as span:
            try:
                result = await super()._agenerate(
                    messages, stop=stop, run_manager=run_manager, **kwargs)
            except Exception as exc:
                self._record_error(span, exc)
                raise
            span.set_attribute("llm.output_messages",
                               _output_texts(result))
            self._record_usage(span, result)
            span.set_attribute("swapdesk.latency_ms",
                               int((time.monotonic() - started) * 1000))
            return result

    def _stream(self, messages, stop=None, run_manager=None, **kwargs):
        started = time.monotonic()
        with self._llm_span(messages) as span:
            try:
                span.set_attribute("swapdesk.streamed", True)
                yield from super()._stream(
                    messages, stop=stop, run_manager=run_manager, **kwargs)
            except Exception as exc:
                self._record_error(span, exc)
                raise
            finally:
                span.set_attribute("swapdesk.latency_ms",
                                   int((time.monotonic() - started) * 1000))

    async def _astream(self, messages, stop=None, run_manager=None,
                       **kwargs):
        started = time.monotonic()
        with self._llm_span(messages) as span:
            try:
                span.set_attribute("swapdesk.streamed", True)
                async for chunk in super()._astream(
                        messages, stop=stop, run_manager=run_manager,
                        **kwargs):
                    yield chunk
            except Exception as exc:
                self._record_error(span, exc)
                raise
            finally:
                span.set_attribute("swapdesk.latency_ms",
                                   int((time.monotonic() - started) * 1000))

Zero paid calls. A scripted subclass stands in for the LiteLLM proxy at

import sys
from pathlib import Path

import pytest
from langchain_core.messages import AIMessage, HumanMessage
from langchain_core.outputs import ChatGeneration, ChatResult

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

from swapdesk.agent import model_spans as _spans  # noqa: E402

    InstrumentedChatOpenAI,

class _FakeSpan:
    def __init__(self, store, name, kind, attrs):
        self._store = store
        self.name = name
        self.kind = kind
        self.attrs = dict(attrs)
        self.status = None

    def set_attribute(self, key, value):
        self.attrs[key] = value

    def set_status(self, status):
        self.status = status

    def __enter__(self):
        return self

    def __exit__(self, *args):
        self._store.append(self)
        return False


@pytest.fixture()
def recorder(monkeypatch):

def _result(text="ok", usage=None):

    def __init__(self, store, name, kind, attrs):
        self._store = store
        self.name = name
        self.kind = kind
        self.attrs = dict(attrs)
        self.status = None

    def set_attribute(self, key, value):
        self.attrs[key] = value

    def set_status(self, status):
        self.status = status

    def __enter__(self):
        return self

    def __exit__(self, *args):
        self._store.append(self)
        return False
